``` html
---
title: "Two Panel Page"
format:
  html:
    css: styles.css
---


<div class="two-panel" id="two-panel">

  <div class="main-panel">

    <h2>Inupiaq</h2>

    <p>
    Taiguaqta by Edna Ahgeak MacLean

    Nukatpiaġruk niksiksuqtuq.

    Niksiksullaturuq.

    Niksiksullatuviñi?
    </p>

  </div>

  <div class="side-panel" id="side-panel">

    <h2>English</h2>

    <p>
    Let's Read! by Edna Agheak MacLean

    The boy is fishing.

    He enjoys fishing.

    Do you like fishing?
    </p>

  </div>

  <button
    class="toggle-button"
    id="toggle-button"
    onclick="togglePanel()">
    ›
  </button>

</div>

<script>
function togglePanel() {

  const container = document.getElementById("two-panel");

  container.classList.toggle("collapsed");

  const button = document.getElementById("toggle-button");

  if (container.classList.contains("collapsed")) {
    button.textContent = "‹";
  } else {
    button.textContent = "›";
  }
}
</script>
```
